purpose: Repo-wide, explicit exemptions for the SCOPE-DIFF check (src/rules/scope-diff-validator.ts). A path matching an entry here is never counted as a scope violation, in any project, without needing to be repeated in every project's own SCOPE.json. This is a reviewable allowlist a human edits and sees in a diff -- not an implicit default, and not a way to bypass the check for anything project-specific.
